feeds.title: IT'S ALL INDIE
feeds.description: It's All Indie is an Indie and Alternative music discovery blog based in United Kingdom. We pride ourselves on finding the best new music around. Keep up with latest news, reviews, interviews, videos and downloads by subscribing this blog.

feeds.title: God Is In The TV
feeds.description: God Is In The TV Zine a music and culture website based in the UK. Featuring news, interviews, reviews, videos, streams, downloads, live music coverage, film and TV.

feeds.title: Indie Dock Music Blog
feeds.description: We are a London-based music blog and we love to discover the best new music from the London indie scene and from all around the world.

feeds.title: Nordic Music Review
feeds.description: The latest Nordic Indie music reviews from across the Scandinavian and Icelandic Music scene.

feeds.title: Indie Music
feeds.description: Covers updates on the freshest new Indie music on a regular basis along with interviews, new releases and Indie music reviews, and news articles.

feeds.title: Is This Music
feeds.description: We are a Scottish-based independent music site. We endeavor to review all the music sent our way. Check out our reviews and opinions in the blog.

feeds.title: Discovery Music Scotland » Indie
feeds.description: Check out the latest and opinion and features from Discovery Music in the Indie genre. Discovery Music Scotland is all about showcasing Scotland's finest music.

feeds.title: The Voice Of Unreason Music Reviews/Gigs/Lists/Features/Video oh my!
feeds.description: Welcome to Arctic Reviews, a totally independent voice for music appreciation and criticism. Running since 2017, UK-based music blog that covers just about everything. Reviews, gigs, lists, interviews, and more.

feeds.title: FVMusic Blog
feeds.description: FVMusic Blog is an Indie Music Blog dedicated to sharing the best new music and artists. If you are searching for reviews, interviews, and features then you are in the right place.

feeds.title: She Makes Music
feeds.description: She Makes Music highlights and puts focus on the best new music made by female-identifying and non-binary artists from all around the world on their website. Keep up-to-date with the music world and discover more brilliant music made by women in this music blog by Helen Evans.

feeds.title: A&R Factory » Indie
feeds.description: Since 2012, we have grown into one of the most respected artist and repertoire (A&R) blogs. We help music industry professionals discover new independent music from across the world. Explore the latest indie music, artists, albums and more!

feeds.title: Cougar Microbes » Indie
feeds.description: Cougar Microbes aims to feature Indie music and artists with timely published articles, news, and more. Cougar Microbes is a London-based music site with a fierce loyalty to the British scene and a keen ear for what is going on globally. Our mission is to feature an array of amazing releases and artists with the goal of promoting them to anyone interested and anyone who stumbles across the site.

feeds.title: Spectral Nights
feeds.description: Spectral Nights is a place where we get to wax lyrical about bands we like, gigs we've been to, and anything else that takes our fancy - from album reviews to new music videos and the occasional interview, festival review and band playlist.

feeds.title: Neon Filler Blog
feeds.description: Neon Filler was created in 2009 by Joe Lepper and Dorian Rogers. Since then it has grown to include articles by our wonderful bunch of contributors, regular Top 10 features and in 2011 we published our Top 100 Indie and Alternative Albums list. Indie Music UK is the home of indie and alt music website.

feeds.title: Turtle Tempo
feeds.description: A London-based music blog that cares about new music. We are committed to giving talented indie & alternative music artists the recognition they deserve.

feeds.title: Right Chord Music Blog » New Music
feeds.description: The RCM Blog champions incredible new music from unsigned and independent artists from all over the world. We help incredible, unsigned and independent artists get their music heard by more people more often.

feeds.title: EQ Music Blog
feeds.description: EQ Music Blog is the authority on new electronic pop and alternative music with daily updates, news, music videos and interviews with the most relevant names in pop music. EQ Music launched in 2005 as a new pop music blog featuring fresh, emerging artists written American born, London dweller Raj Rudolph. Not satisfied with top 40 radio, EQ Music set out on a mission to discover relevant and inspiring new talent in the pop, electronic and indie-pop genres.

feeds.title: Indie is not a genre
feeds.description: Indie is not a genre is an independent music blog that covers new Indie albums, reviews, interviews and concert livestreams. We are an independent source for new music from the UK, Australia, Canada and beyond.

feeds.title: A. Room
feeds.description: Covers news and reviews of the best in experimental, indie and electronic music. Featuring the bizarre, unusual but always great works of experimental artists from around the globe.

feeds.title: RCRD LBL » Indie
feeds.description: A platform supporting up-and-coming music talent across the globe where artists can upload their music, sell their music and grow their fanbase. Explore the latest indie music numbers, artists, albums and more!

feeds.title: Mix It All Up
feeds.description: Mix It All Up is a music blog which talks about signed and/or unsigned bands. Bringing you music news, reviews, interviews and photographs from across the South of England and beyond.

feeds.title: IndieCentralMusic
feeds.description: Discovering New Music since October 2014. IndieCentralMusic is the home of the latest indie and alternative music. Follow this blog to find the latest indie and alternative music news, reviews, and discoveries, along with radio, TV & gigs!

feeds.title: Hit The Floor Magazine » Indie
feeds.description: Get all the latest Indie Music Interviews, Gig Footage, Exclusives, Sessions and more from Hit The Floor Magazine. Established in 2010, Hit The Floor is a source for all the latest happenings in Music industry of UK.

feeds.title: The UK Number Ones Blog » Indie
feeds.description: Join me as I listen to every UK Number 1 single since the charts began. Each and every song to have claimed the top spot since 1952. Find all the top and popular indie music in this section.

feeds.title: Indie Top 39
feeds.description: Indie Top 39 is an independent music blog founded by Dov Zavado. Our mission is to introduce you to the best new indie artists.

feeds.title: Sounds Indie
feeds.description: Sounds Indie is a music blog focussing on unsigned acts from absolutely anywhere.

feeds.title: Edge of Arcady
feeds.description: Edge of Arcady is here to show off the music we love. Indie, alternative, or whatever. Exciting new bands alongside established acts. Signed or unsigned - in the internet age, what does it matter? As long as the music is thrilling, vital, and created to instigate a global or personal revolution. Although our main go-to bands are guitar-based, if we like the sound of an artist we'll write about them.

feeds.title: KLOF Magazine
feeds.description: The UK's leading online Folk Music Magazine covers independent Non-mainstream music including Folk, Acoustic, Americana, Experimental, and Alternative music. Founded in 2004 by Alex Gallacher, KLOF Mag is an eclectic music and culture zine featuring recommendations and reviews, interviews & guest features, and more. Their writers include journalists, former writers for the music press, and those who share their passion for the music they love.

feeds.title: Various Small Flames
feeds.description: At Various Small Flames, we believe that music and writing have the power to connect people and help them better understand themselves and each other. We are dedicated to sharing music from independent artists, especially home recordings and DIY labels, that we feel do this particularly well.

feeds.title: It's Indie
feeds.description: it's indie and we know it is here to bring you the very best of indie music, from the newest indie artists in the United Kingdom and beyond. We mainly cover UK indie music reviews but we will also bring you the latest music from around the world. We're particularly fond of pop and rock - it's all indie to us.

feeds.title: IndieGems UK
feeds.description: Discover the best of independent music. Stay up to date with indie music reviews, news, artists, interviews and more!

feeds.title: Indie Midlands
feeds.description: Get to know about Indie & Alternative Music in the West Midland and beyond, IndieMidlands is the site dedicated to that! Keeping you up to date with all the latest gigs and music in the West Midlands and more.

feeds.title: Indietronica
feeds.description: Indietronica is a new music blog dedicated to providing news and sounds from the music genre indietronica, which combines elements of indie, electro, electronica, rock and pop.
